generations.prompt_sent: subject: A cinematic full-screen Webex MCP Server orchestration infographic with one stable central cyan-and-teal MCP hub and six clean unlabeled outcome nodes representing Customer notifications through Messages, Incident response through Rooms and Memberships, Account collaboration through Teams and Spaces, Access governance through People and Memberships, Event automation through Webhooks and Events, and Knowledge and approvals through ECM, Room Tabs, and Attachment Actions; all critical labels will be added later as verified vector overlays, so the generated pixels contain no letters, numbers, logos, captions, pseudo-code, fake product UI, or watermark; action: A cyan pulse enters the central hub, the six outcome nodes activate sequentially in the narration order with coherent connector flows and restrained success glows, then the complete system holds long enough to read before the camera retraces its path toward the original portal; node positions, icon geometry, colors, connector routing, and lighting remain stable throughout, with no object duplication, topology change, flicker, misshapen icons, or unexplained particles; scene: Deep navy spatial canvas derived from the repository’s webex-mcp-business-outcomes information architecture, with generous margins, a subtle technical grid, crisp geometric icons for notification, incident, account team, access shield, event flow, and enterprise knowledge approval, consistent spacing, and open areas reserved for post-production typography; style: Premium enterprise editorial motion graphic with flat-to-2.5D geometry, deep navy, cyan, teal, blue, and restrained violet, crisp high-contrast edges, controlled bloom used only for active data flow, visually aligned with the presenter studio, no dense dashboard, no tiny ornamental elements, no rendered words, and no spelling risk; camera_angle: Centered orthographic-to-shallow-perspective view facing the MCP hub head-on, with symmetrical six-node layout and no extreme lens distortion; camera_movement: Begin as though passing through the same cyan portal from scene one, ease into a measured forward push toward the central hub, add a subtle clockwise parallax arc while the six nodes activate, hold the complete composition, then smoothly pull back on the same axis to a portal-sized framing for the cut back to the presenter, with no abrupt cuts, whip pans, camera roll, or spatial discontinuity; sound_effects: Low warm technology ambience, one soft inbound pulse, six delicate activation ticks synchronized to the nodes, a restrained completion shimmer, no speech, no vocals, no loud bass hit, and no distracting musical change.

evals.feedback: The first six seconds provide strong repository-aligned iconography, exactly six stable outcome nodes, sequential activation, coherent connectors, clean color, and readable motion. Refine because the final pullback invents a corridor of dashboard panels containing tiny garbled pseudo-text, breaking the requested open navy canvas, no-text constraint, and spatial continuity back to the presenter portal.
